inherited_brief.statement: Automatically resolve and post eligible invoice exceptions without a separate accounts-payable review.
inherited_brief.limitations: The sold brief omitted the policy-controlled approval and recovery paths.

process_knower.basis: Owns the queue and exception escalation path.

operator.basis: Performed the observed review and correction.

disposition_authority.basis: Directly owns the operating boundary for invoice exceptions.

verifier.basis: Independently verifies correction accuracy and posting control compliance.

representative_case.population_scope: Domestic supplier invoices in the price-variance exception queue.
representative_case.limitations: The case proves the review path occurred, not its frequency across the population.

claims.statement: The service will automatically post eligible resolved invoice exceptions.
claims.scope: Eligible invoice exceptions described by the SOW.

claims.statement: A designated reviewer must approve every invoice correction before posting.
claims.scope: All invoice corrections under controls-policy revision 8.

claims.statement: The operator reviewed evidence, corrected the record, and approved posting in case 1042.
The current invoice system stages a correction and requires a separate authenticated approval event.

conflicts.affected_boundary: Whether the service can approve and post or may only recommend and stage a correction.

proposal.statement: Classify the exception, assemble cited evidence, and stage a correction while a reviewer retains approval and posting authority.
proposal.safe_fallback: Continue the existing manual queue and use model output only as a non-authoritative recommendation.
proposal.next_field_move: Observe ten eligible cases and measure recommendation accuracy, reviewer effort, coverage, and exceptions.
proposal.affected_boundary: Recommendation and staging are included; approval and posting are excluded.

disposition.authority_basis: Directly accountable for the invoice-exception service boundary.
disposition.scope: Recommendation-only pilot for domestic price-variance exceptions.
disposition.source_passage: Proceed with recommendation and staging; approval and posting remain reviewer-controlled.
disposition.rationale: This boundary tests value while preserving policy and current recovery behavior.

downstream_impacts.reason: The workflow boundary no longer includes automatic approval or posting.
The evaluation must measure recommendation quality and reviewer effort.
The accepted source and access boundary did not change.

chronology.summary: Preserved the automatic-posting statement from the sold brief.
Observed the reviewer-controlled correction path for case 1042.
Recorded the conflict between sold automation and current authority.
Proposed a recommendation-only workflow with a manual fallback.
Accepted the bounded kickoff and retained reviewer posting authority.
